page_title: CRY 0-1 ARS | Crystal Palace v Arsenal 21/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, David Coote has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but Aaron Ramsdale comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace).
90+5' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
90+4' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+3' Good movement by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
90+1' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) has tested the patience of referee David Coote and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Martin Odegaard is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal).
89' Substitution. Bukayo Saka did his best and is replaced by Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal).
88' A lofted cross from Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
88' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
87' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
86' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.
84' The ball is cleared after Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Crystal Palace win a corner.
84' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
83' Roy Hodgson has decided to substitute Joel Ward and he is replaced by Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace).
82' Gabriel (Arsenal) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee David Coote saw the whole situation.
81' The ball possession at the moment is 40:60.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eddie Nketiah leaves the pitch and Jorginho (Arsenal) comes on.
78' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
77' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
75' David Coote couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) and blew his whistle.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) for Jeffrey Schlupp.
72' PENALTY APPEAL after Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
70' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
70' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel (Arsenal) replacing Gabriel Martinelli.
69' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) commits a rough challenge and David Coote blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Crystal Palace.
67' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!
67' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Kai Havertz (Arsenal) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post.
66' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
63' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

63' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Sam Johnstone was alert and the score remains the same. The linesman points to the corner flag, Arsenal are going to take it.
61' David Coote has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kai Havertz (Arsenal).
60' The referee is firm and issues Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) a deserved yellow card.
58' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
57' David Coote blows his whistle for a foul after William Saliba (Arsenal) hacks down one of his opponents. Crystal Palace have a free kick from a promising distance.
56' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
55' Good chance! Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
53' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Sam Johnstone no chance!
53' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is going to take the penalty!
53' Referee David Coote is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Arsenal!
52' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Arsenal, he's going to review using VAR.

51' Sam Johnstone (Crystal Palace) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. David Coote stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. PENALTY to Arsenal! Great chance to score.
51' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
50' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

50' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Arsenal comes to nothing.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley well wide of the right post from inside the box.
42' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

42' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Sam Johnstone, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Arsenal will take a corner kick.
40' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
38' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
36' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
35' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
33' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
31' David Coote blows for a foul after Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
30' 4:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
29' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the right post!

28' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the left post.
27' David Coote shows a yellow card to Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) for his blatant foul.
26' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
25' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Aaron Ramsdale, who smothers the ball.
24' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
21' The ball rebounds to Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift well wide of the left post.
21' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
20' The resulting corner from Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is cleared.

18' A pass into the penalty area from Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) is intercepted by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

16' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed towards the left post, but it was an easy job for the keeper to make a save.
15' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Aaron Ramsdale intercepts the ball.
15' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
14' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) launches a cross from the corner, but Sam Johnstone is alert to thwart the effort.
14' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. It will be a corner kick for Arsenal.
11' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Sam Johnstone makes a comfortable save.
8' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
7' A long ball forward to Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) is intercepted.
4' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
4' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
2' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Arsenal will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
David Coote got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
